quotes.text: The middle-click message test exceeded its timeout mainly in CCOV code coverage builds. The accepted patch raises its timeout multiplier from two to three only when AppConstants.MOZ_CODE_COVERAGE is true and deletes both created folders in registered cleanup, allowing ./mach test --verify to repeat without leftover folders. This supports a narrow environment-specific timeout after test isolation, not a blanket timeout increase for other failures.
